source.name: Netflix Movies and TV Shows dataset by Shivam Bansal
source.publisher: Kaggle dataset author; Zenodo preservation snapshot

checks: no duplicate title and type rows
same-year share among US additions rounds to 72.2% in 2015 and 28.1% in 2021
same-year TV share among US additions rounds to 40.0% in 2015 and 61.1% in 2021
US movie deep-library share (acquisition lag over five years) in interpreted drama and children/family clusters rounds to 5.5% and 16.4% before 2018, then 47.4% and 48.0% in 2018 to 2021
top 50 directors include 421 of 5,941 movies with recorded director; documentary share is 13.4% of all attributed movies and 1.4% in top-50 titles
UK release-vintage metadata check has 86 titles from the 2020s, with 12.8% sparse by the stated three-field rule

evidenceBoundary: Catalog metadata and acquisition timing are not viewing, retention, title quality, licensing intent, or financial performance. Cluster names are analyst interpretations of dominant genre features. The sparse metadata indicator covers director, cast, and country only.
